about.text:
Role: an accessibility reviewer. Question: which doors of the Duplex are narrower than the 850 mm minimum, and where are they?
Rule (an assumption, not legal advice): a door on an accessible path needs at least 850 mm clear width, as NBC 2020 (National Building Code of Canada) 3.8.3.12 is cited by the NRC door check (samples/nrc/door_verdicts.csv, rule DC-W1, marked illustrative). The 'rule' node holds the number and its source, and every step reads it from there.
What is measured: the model has no Pset_DoorCommon.ClearWidth on any door, so the width checked is the IFC OverallWidth ('doors'), leaf plus frame as exported. Clear width is never larger, so a fail is certain and a pass is provisional until clear width is measured. A door with no width is 'unknown' (PassScore empty, grey in both panes), never a pass or a fail.
How to read it: 'chart' counts doors per 50 mm of width, red bins below 850 mm and green at or above, with an 'unknown' bar for doors with no width; the Vega-Lite spec draws the 850 mm rule as a vertical line. 'doorTable' lists every door with its verdict. The 3D view shares the red-green scale: failing doors are red and every other element is faded to 15 percent ('ghosted').
The verdicts for the Duplex are in samples/viz-analyses/README.md.

doors.sql: SELECT e.StepId, e.GlobalId, e.Type, s.StoreyName AS Storey, TRY_CAST(w.Value AS DOUBLE) AS Width_m FROM EntityText e LEFT JOIN StoreyOfElement s ON s.EntityIndex = e.EntityIndex AND s.Depth = 1 LEFT JOIN ParameterText w ON w.EntityIndex = e.EntityIndex AND w.Name = 'Ifc:OverallWidth' WHERE e.Category = 'IFCDOOR' ORDER BY e.StepId

rule.rows: [{"RuleId":"DC-W1","MinWidth_mm":850.0,"Source":"NBC 2020 3.8.3.12 as cited by samples/nrc/door_verdicts.csv (illustrative, not legal text)"}]

verdicts.sql: SELECT d.StepId, d.GlobalId, d.Storey, d.Type, d.Width_mm, r.MinWidth_mm, r.RuleId, CASE WHEN d.Width_mm IS NULL THEN 'unknown' WHEN d.Width_mm >= r.MinWidth_mm THEN 'pass' ELSE 'fail' END AS Verdict, CASE WHEN d.Width_mm IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN d.Width_mm >= r.MinWidth_mm THEN CAST(1 AS DOUBLE) ELSE CAST(0 AS DOUBLE) END AS PassScore FROM t1 d CROSS JOIN t2 r ORDER BY d.Width_mm NULLS LAST, d.StepId

doorTable.title: Door widths against the 850 mm minimum
doorTable.columns: StepId, GlobalId, Storey, Type, Width_mm, MinWidth_mm, Verdict

histogram.sql: WITH known AS (SELECT CAST(floor(Width_mm / 50) * 50 AS BIGINT) AS BinStart_mm FROM t1 WHERE Width_mm IS NOT NULL), bins AS (SELECT range AS BinStart_mm FROM range((SELECT min(BinStart_mm) FROM known), (SELECT max(BinStart_mm) FROM known) + 50, 50)) SELECT CAST(b.BinStart_mm AS VARCHAR) || '-' || CAST(b.BinStart_mm + 50 AS VARCHAR) || ' mm' AS Bin, b.BinStart_mm, b.BinStart_mm + 50 AS BinEnd_mm, (SELECT count(*) FROM known k WHERE k.BinStart_mm = b.BinStart_mm) AS Doors, CASE WHEN b.BinStart_mm >= r.MinWidth_mm THEN CAST(1 AS DOUBLE) WHEN b.BinStart_mm + 50 <= r.MinWidth_mm THEN CAST(0 AS DOUBLE) ELSE CAST(0.5 AS DOUBLE) END AS PassScore, r.MinWidth_mm FROM bins b CROSS JOIN t2 r UNION ALL SELECT 'unknown', NULL, NULL, (SELECT count(*) FROM t1 WHERE Width_mm IS NULL), NULL, (SELECT MinWidth_mm FROM t2) ORDER BY BinStart_mm NULLS LAST

chart.title: Doors per 50 mm of width (red: below 850 mm)
